line.name: E.P. Carrillo Encore Black
line.background_text: One of three 2024 line extensions that elevated Encore from a sub-line of the Perez-Carrillo portfolio into its own standalone brand. Swaps the original Encore's all-Nicaraguan, medium-bodied blend for a dark Connecticut Broadleaf maduro wrapper over San Andres binder, produced at Casa Carrillo (formerly Tabacalera La Alianza).

research_notes: Genuinely distinct from plain Encore (different wrapper/binder, fuller profile). Sources disagree slightly on exact length (5 3/8" vs 5 3/4") - treated as approximate. Only one vitola offered as of Sept 2026.

research_sources.supports: wrapper/binder/filler, size, release date, price, box count
